paper_title: Shifting Long-Context LLMs Research from Input to Output
caption: Proportion of real-user demand: The aforementioned 2K range refers to the interval [2K, 4K), and similarly for the other ranges. Solid color fill for input demand, slash fill for output demand in the Wildchat dataset.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the proportion of real-user demand for input and output in the Wildchat dataset, categorized by different ranges (2K, 4K, 8K, and 16K). The horizontal axis is not labeled, but it contains four categories corresponding to the different ranges. The vertical axis is labeled "Number" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 120,000, with tick labels at intervals of 20,000. Each category is represented by two bars: a solid-colored bar for input demand and a diagonally striped bar for output demand. The 2K range has a solid yellow bar with a value of 9320 and a striped yellow bar with a value of 78188; the 4K range has a solid orange bar with a value of 3784 and a striped orange bar with a value of 108494; the 8K range has a solid blue bar with a value of 1401 and a striped blue bar with a value of 17865; the 16K range has a solid dark blue bar with a value of 832 and a striped dark blue bar with a value of 4247. The bars are grouped by category, with the input and output bars placed side by side for each range. The chart does not display any specific sorting order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
